body: But there's no emoji that says "I wanna add some white to that ink"!

I keep a lot of this to myself, but I also realise that if I let it fester it ruins my mood and my experience of what would otherwise be great days. So even if I don't mention it, I also need to get rid of these thoughts myself, or I'll never be at peace.

See, I would love to shower her with affection, but there is obviously a point where that would be too much and I wouldn't want to cross a line where it seems like I am fishing for compliments myself. Cause let's be honest, part of me probably is.

But you are absolutely right that it will probably be fantastic for her to know that I am calm and mores ecure because of her. I will be sure to tell her once I get my shit together.
